title: Stanford's AI Research Method Everyone Should Know
description:
Fix AI bias with Stanford's STORM method for more accurate, multi-perspective research results.

AI often generates one-sided or inaccurate information, but the STORM framework forces models to analyze topics from diverse viewpoints like economists and researchers. This approach creates much more reliable content than standard prompting.

Learn how to apply this technique to your own research workflows today.

Subscribe for more practical AI research tips and comment if you want a STORM tutorial.
